context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter on a building safety story
purpose: Teach: 因果/国交/アスベスト/ウィルス/参戦/周期/モダン/効用

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: ご足労ありがとう。今日は例のモダン建築の倒壊事故について説明します。
lines.en: Thanks for coming. Today I'll explain the collapse incident at that modern building.
lines.style: Formal officer tone, measured and professional briefing voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: よろしくお願いします。学生新聞として、因果関係を正確に伝えたいんです。
lines.en: Thank you. As the student paper, we want to report the causal relationship accurately.
lines.style: Eager young reporter, polite but probing journalistic tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 結論から言うと、老朽化したアスベストの除去工事中に上部の梁が落下しました。
lines.en: To put it bluntly, an upper beam fell during asbestos removal on the aging structure.
lines.style: Direct factual delivery, officer summarizing findings concisely.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国交省の点検記録では、一定の周期で検査が義務付けられていましたよね?
lines.en: Per the Ministry of Land records, inspections were required on a set cycle, right?
lines.style: Sharp follow-up question, reporter checking known facts carefully.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: その通り。記録上は問題なしだったが、形だけの検査では何の効用もない。
lines.en: Correct. Records showed no issues, but token inspections have no real effect.
lines.style: Slightly frustrated, candid admission from a seasoned officer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 現場の作業員の方々の健康被害は? 行政はウィルス対策ほど真剣に取り組んでくれますか。
lines.en: What about the workers' health damage? Will authorities tackle it as seriously as virus countermeasures?
lines.style: Concerned humanitarian angle, thoughtful follow-up from reporter.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 全員の健康診断を進めています。警察もこの捜査に本格的に参戦しました。
lines.en: We're conducting health checks for everyone. Police have now seriously joined this investigation.
lines.style: Reassuring authority, signaling serious institutional commitment clearly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。市民が安心できる記事に仕上げます。
lines.en: Thank you very much. I'll write an article that reassures the citizens.
lines.style: Grateful closing, sincere young journalist wrapping up respectfully.
